howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Matrix 频道支持:从 channels 分支拷入 Matrix 适配器、注册到频道入口、安装固定版本的适配器包、修补 ESM 导入并构建验证,再引导你创建独立机器人账号并写入凭据。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Matrix 频道时启动:先执行 Apply 里的拷贝、注册、装包、修补、构建与测试,再按凭据部分手动创建机器人账号并选择认证方式。

say.text: 给我的 NanoClaw 接入 Matrix 频道
say.note: 会从 channels 分支拷入适配器并注册

say.text: 按 Option B 用访问令牌配置 Matrix
构建报 matrix-js-sdk 的 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND
say.note: 会重跑 ESM 扩展名修补再构建

howto.what_en: Adds Matrix support to NanoClaw: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, pins the package, patches its ESM imports, and builds. It also guides you through creating a separate bot account and writing credentials.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to wire Matrix into NanoClaw: it runs the Apply steps (copy, register, install, patch, build, test), then the credential steps you do by hand in Element.

say_en.text: Add Matrix channel support to my NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies and registers the Matrix adapter

say_en.text: Set up Matrix with an access token (Option B)
Build fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for matrix-js-sdk
say_en.note: Re-runs the ESM extension patch, then builds
